question_or_proposition: For Federal FY2025, does the Part I requirement to perform Daphnia pulex whole effluent toxicity testing once per quarter (24-hour composite sample; report NOEC) apply at that stated frequency throughout the fiscal year, or is it modified, reduced, or suspended by the additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions and frequency reduction option referenced in footnote *9 and specified in Part II?
required_context: Part II whole effluent toxicity testing requirements
Permit effective date and its relationship to Federal FY2025
notes: The nominated row sets report-only NOEC monitoring at once/quarter, but footnote *9 explicitly points to Part II for additional WET conditions and a frequency reduction option. Without resolving that interaction, whether once/quarter Daphnia pulex WET monitoring was actually required during FY2025 (Purpose B) and how to classify quarters lacking WET results (Purpose C) cannot be determined.
